physicalIdentity.conclusion: Old Rostov-on-Don airfield and new Platov are separate airports; a federal order opens one and closes the other.

iata.conclusion: ROV at old Rostov observed 2016-03-19; Aeroflot (citing IATA) dates ROV to Platov and temporary RVI to the old airport from 2017-11-27.

icao.conclusion: URRR/URRP not admitted: no retrieved AIP amendment or dated primary indicator record.

historicalBoundary.conclusion: ROV/RVI switch on 2017-11-27 at day precision; passenger move 2017-12-07 and legal closure 2018-03-01 are separate and not used as code boundaries; RVI end open.

historicalNames.conclusion: No official-name interval admitted; display labels are reference only.

closureAndReplacement.conclusion: Legal civil closure 2018-03-01 directly established; not a code withdrawal.

negativeResults: IATA notice attached to the Aeroflot circular not retrieved.
remainingGaps: Exact time of day of the 2017-11-27 switch.
followUps.nextAction: Obtain the IATA notice or a GDS bulletin to narrow the switch instant and find any RVI withdrawal; seek Russian AIP AIRAC pages for URRP/URRR.

physicalIdentity.conclusion: Laishan and Penglai are separate sites 57 km apart by road.

iata.conclusion: YNT observed at Laishan on 2014-11-10 and approved for Penglai; complete civil transfer on 2015-05-28 00:00; current AIP shows YNT at Penglai.

icao.conclusion: ZSYT not admitted: Laishan 2013 chart and Penglai 2025 AIP lack a changeover record.

historicalBoundary.conclusion: YNT switch uncertain anywhere from 2014-11-10 to 2015-05-28; neither the planned 2014-12-11 update nor the opening is asserted as the switch.

closureAndReplacement.conclusion: Laishan civil use replaced by Penglai at 2015-05-28 00:00; continued military use not modelled.

remainingGaps: Earlier dated YNT observation at Laishan (start before 2014-11-11 unknown).
followUps.nextAction: Retrieve CAAC AIRAC 1506 amendment or Travelsky/IATA bulletin; find a pre-2014 dated YNT observation to tighten the Laishan start.

physicalIdentity.conclusion: Pochentong (old PNH/VDPP) and greenfield Techo are separate airports; Kratie is a third, unadmitted site.

iata.conclusion: PNH observed at Pochentong (2008-12-31 reference) and used until operations moved at 00:01 on 2025-09-09; KTI filed for Techo by 2025-07-22.

historicalBoundary.conclusion: PNH and VDPP ends have earliest bounds only (no withdrawal records); KTI and VDTI starts have latest bounds only (allocation dates unknown). AIP effective date, airline move and IATA allocation are kept distinct.

closureAndReplacement.conclusion: Techo replaced Pochentong for civil service; aerodrome closure is not indicator withdrawal.
